description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, causes [Imperil Wind 20% (25s)], grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Serafie)] and [Wind Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
